record_title: An explicit iterated-log lower bound for the finite Garsia rearrangement constant
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The lower bound is asymptotic with an enormous threshold and is not claimed sharp. It applies to the complex unit-modulus finite-system formulation; no quantitative real-valued analogue is asserted. The six-fold iterated logarithm reflects the stated quantitative Szemeredi input and remains far below Bourgain's O(log log N) upper bound. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with the main residual risk coming from contemporaneous or not-yet-indexed discussion of the September 2026 Lewko preprint. No independent validation is asserted.
